entities.summary: José Gutiérrez de la Concha e Irigoyen, 1st Marquis of Havana, 1st Viscount of Cuba, Grandee of Spain was a Spanish noble, general, and politician who served three times as Captain General of Cuba and once as the Prime Minister of Spain.
